title: Options Composer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 116. The model's own job is narrow -- write 2 alternates for an already-drafted, already-QA'd piece of copy, each materially distinct from the original on one declared axis, and recommend one. Assembling the full OptionCard (contracts/option-card.schema.json) -- lettering the options, running per-option QA, setting autonomy_level/risk_tier/timeout behaviour from policies/autonomy-matrix.yaml -- is orchestrator code (services/orchestrator/orchestrator/dispatch.py's compose_options_handler calling services/options_inbox/cards.py's build_card), not this model's job. That split mirrors every other drafting handler in this codebase: the model writes copy, dispatch.py owns the contract.

original_draft_text.description: The already-drafted, already-QA'd Wednesday copy this card's first option (A) is built from.

proof_points.description: The {claim, source} pairs this week's research brief carried -- an alternate may reuse these, never invent a new one.

text.description: Full replacement copy for this alternate -- not a diff, not a summary.

distinctness_axis.description: What materially differs from original_draft_text (hook, proof point, audience angle, format, length). Two options differing only cosmetically are not distinct -- see prompt.md's distinctness test.

recommended.description: Which of the three options (the original draft, or one of the two alternates above, in order) this function recommends.
